text:
sasha: FYI Acme just requested onboarding of `Orchid-11B` into Private. Needs int8 quant, p95 latency <180ms, and <3% quality regression vs FP16 on their SQuAD-like eval. HF: https://hf.co/acme/orchid-11b. Can eng-ml triage?

aj: can you confirm target hw + exact eval set? also drop model weights or s3 path.

sasha: target is dedicated G4-like infra (we might use A10G for staging). Eval set = Acme SQuAD-400 + a 200-doc internal QA set. They prefer int8 for cost. I pasted S3 link to prompts in the ticket.

maria: I'll kick off a quick smoke: FP16 baseline + int8 static + GPTQ 4-bit baseline. Will report throughput, p95 token latency, and SQuAD F1 delta.

maria: quick smoke results (staging single A10G): FP16 throughput ~120 tok/s, int8 static ~240 tok/s; SQuAD F1 FP16=88.2, int8=85.4 (~3.2% drop). Command used: ```./bench --model hf/acme/orchid-11b --quant int8 --prompt-set s3://acme/evals/squad400 --batch 8 --max-len 512```

liu: >3% is borderline. Need per-example diffs to see if it's systematic (e.g., numeric hallucination) or specific tokens. Try hybrid quant (activations FP16, weights int8) and qlora-style outlier clipping.

devon: I'll provision `staging-ded-2` with reserved slot for a GRU canary run; ETA ~2h.

oncall-bot: deploy request #5678 queued to staging-ded-2. ETA 2h.

sasha: meeting? can we schedule a 30m triage at 11am tomorrow to decide fallback (int16/hybrid) vs keep int8 and mitigate via prompt engineering? Also need an ask from kernel team if there's a fast-path for attention kernels. :eyes:

maria: will open tracking issue with perf logs, per-example diffs, and the bench command + exact env (torch 2.2, cuda 12.1, kernels v3). tagging @aj for kernel review and @liu for quant experiments.

aj: will look into kernel/vectorized GEMM path; if we can shave p95 for int8 we might keep it.

maria: summary action items: 1) run hybrid int8/FP16 eval (maria, 2h) 2) per-example diffs on SQuAD (maria, today) 3) small GPTQ variant with 4-bit O2 clipping (liu, tomorrow) 4) kernel perf check (aj, ASAP) 5) canary run on staging-ded-2 (devon, ETA 2h).
